messages:
sara_cs: Heads-up — AcmeDev (maria@acme) redeemed a promo link yesterday but the 14-day trial credit landed on their archived workspace 'acme-old' instead of their active 'acme-main'. Customer can't access credits (API calls hitting 402). Promo code: TRIAL-14-ACME. Redeem event id evt_20240914_142311. Need help moving credits or reissuing.

tom_billing: Can you paste the redeem event payload and both org/workspace ids so I can verify ledger entries?

sara_cs: Pasting payload and quick query results below.
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_20240914_142311",
  "promo_code": "TRIAL-14-ACME",
  "redeemed_by_email": "maria@acme.com",
  "redeemed_at": "2024-09-14T14:23:11Z",
  "allocated_to_org": "org_4321",
  "amount_cents": 0,
  "trial_days": 14
}
```
And DB check: 
```sql
SELECT id, org_id, status, created_at FROM workspaces WHERE org_id IN ('org_4321','org_8765');
-- ws_001 | org_4321 | archived | 2021-03-12
-- ws_010 | org_8765 | active   | 2022-11-01
```
Customer says they used the manual redeem link from the onboarding email; their current active org is org_8765.

jin_eng: Sounds like the promo service matched the user to an existing user record tied to org_4321 (maybe older SSO mapping). Two safe options:
1) Transfer the trial allocation from org_4321 -> org_8765 using the admin credits transfer endpoint (preserves audit).
2) Revoke the redemption and reissue a fresh promo to maria@acme.com on the correct org (safer if unsure about historical ledger implications).
I lean to transfer so customer keeps same redemption id.

billing-bot: [automated] promo_redeem logged: evt_20240914_142311 | promo=TRIAL-14-ACME | user=maria@acme.com | allocated_to=org_4321 | time=2024-09-14T14:23:11Z

jin_eng: If we proceed with transfer, example admin call (internal only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/admin/credits/transfer 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"from_org":"org_4321","to_org":"org_8765","amount_cents":0,"trial_days":14,"reason":"redeemed to archived workspace; customer requested transfer","initiated_by":"sara_cs"}'
```
Make sure to include an audit note and manager approval; also confirm there won't be a duplicate active promo for the same email.

tom_billing: I'll need a signoff in the billing change log and will validate ledger impacts. @jin_eng can you verify the transfer endpoint will mark the original redemption as transferred (not double-count)? Also need to record who approved.

sara_cs: Maria confirmed she's still using the same SSO account and consents to transfer. I'll wait 30m for final checks — planning to run transfer during light traffic. :white_check_mark:

tom_billing: Approved. I'll update the billing change log now and run the transfer once @jin_eng confirms the endpoint behavior.

sara_cs: Thanks — I'll DM Maria when done and update the support ticket. Follow-up: we should add a reconcile in the promo flow to prefer active workspaces when multiple org mappings exist (file a small engineering task after this).
